prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to pick up an empty uncapped test tube from test tube rack 2 and move it to dispensing device to draw silicone solution.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is an empty uncapped test tube on test tube rack 2.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Indoor lab automation setup against a pale grey wall. Centre-left: a black rack with several cylindrical wells, most empty; one tube stands upright in it carrying an orange screw cap, its body holding pinkish-red liquid. Behind the rack sits a blue finned/ribbed module with small metal fittings on top. Left of centre, a white square housing with a dark circular opening sits on a white shelf, beside a rail with black rollers and a QR/ArUco marker label. A vertical grey aluminium extrusion column with bolt heads runs up the right side, topped by a magenta sign with a black marker. Another marker card is mounted low centre. Right edge: white worktop, aluminium rails and a dark screen. Signage reads "...ion Area".
observations: The only test tube in the rack has an orange screw cap and contains liquid, meaning it is neither empty nor uncapped.
